verdict.rationale: The docs show a quick one-line install via a Docker image (`docker run ... localai/localai:latest`), and LocalAI is described as 'one binary', so a fast install path exists. However, Docker is a container registry rather than a standard OS or language package manager, and nothing in the evidence shows a Homebrew, apt, pip, npm or similar package. Missing for 10: any documented package-manager install (brew/apt/winget/pip etc.), independent corroboration of install speed, and per-platform install docs.
